acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group manages all necessary permit coordination for hardscaping projects, a critical component of our integrated design-build process. We understand the specific requirements in Fort Worth, Alameda, Albany, and Berkeley, and handle the submissions to ensure your project complies with local building codes and regulations. This comprehensive approach removes the burden from homeowners, preventing delays and ensuring the project proceeds smoothly and legally from conception to final inspection, reflecting our commitment to a managed process.
